scope: Independent local review of the registry-authenticated L40S screen retry preparation and bounded private-image-pull failure handling.

reported_first_attempt.failure: Private image pull returned unauthorized because the pod create request omitted the already-registered Docker Hub credential ID.
reported_first_attempt.operator_action: User interrupted the attempt; coordinator reports a read-only GET of that pod returned 404.

validation.test_scope: All RunPod calls and SSH lifecycle were mocked. The SSE test returned a synthetic HTTP 200 body with curl exit code 28. No live pod, image pull, model download, or GPU measurement was performed.

corrective_contract.registry_preflight: Before any POST, read GET /registries/cmv2myqnw003lvauwsz43uqnt and require ID cmv2myqnw003lvauwsz43uqnt and name dsic3007-dockerhub-aryamudas.
corrective_contract.pod_request: Include the existing registry credential ID in the create request; do not read, export, persist, or log the registry password/token.
corrective_contract.attempt_ownership: Persist registry ID in attempt metadata and require it to match along with attempt name, image, GPU, and existing volume mount before teardown. Older attempts without a registry ID can match only a response with no registry ID.
corrective_contract.private_image_failure: Poll pod status within the bounded 600-second boot phase. When EXITED, make a bounded four-second system-log request; accept HTTP 200 with curl timeout exit 28 and parse the returned SSE tail for decisive image-pull failures. A fatal match stops uploads/model work and tears down only this exact attempt once.
corrective_contract.attempt_budget: CLI cap must be finite and >90 seconds through 1800 seconds; the overall cash cap remains $0.75 and deadline includes startup, staging, load, failure, retrieval, and teardown.
corrective_contract.volumes: The existing 50GB STANDARD volume k6u810gze3 is reused and retained; registry correction introduces no volume lifecycle call.

regressions_covered: Wrong or missing registry identity blocks before pod creation.
Fatal unauthorized image-pull SSE stops before any archive/helper upload, performs one POST only, and deletes only the owned pod while preserving the network volume.
HTTP 200 SSE data is parsed even when curl reports code 28 after its bounded four-second tail request.
NaN, infinity, 90 seconds, and 1801 seconds are rejected as screen lease caps before preflight.
Existing lifecycle, account-pod pagination, no-secret logging/request, ambiguous-create guard, runner self-hash, and diagnostic-only synthetic receipt checks remain passing.
remaining_limits: The registry fix has not been exercised against a live paid create request or actual private image pull.
Actual pod RAM/VRAM, CUDA runtime, exact billed storage, model weight availability, fit, throughput, and numerical equivalence remain unmeasured.
Storage is budgeted at a conservative $0.02/hour allowance, not represented as an account-specific all-in invoice.
